description: Implement connection rate limiting on WebSocket gateway with exponential backoff for failed authentication attempts
approach: Leverage existing RateLimiterService and WebSocketSecurityConfig to add rate limiting on connection attempts per IP. Implement exponential backoff tracking for failed authentication attempts using Redis. Add rate limit checks before authentication in handleConnection.

tasks.title: Create WebSocket connection rate limiter service
tasks.description: Create a dedicated service for WebSocket connection rate limiting with exponential backoff support for failed auth attempts

modification_points.reason: Dedicated service for WebSocket connection rate limiting with backoff

implementation: Create ws-connection-rate-limiter.service.ts in websocket module
Inject RateLimiterService and EnvService
Implement checkConnectionRateLimit(ip: string): Promise<{allowed: boolean, retryAfterMs?: number}>
Use webSocketSecurity.connectRateLimitPerIp and connectRateLimitWindowSeconds from EnvService
Implement recordFailedAuth(ip: string): Promise<void> to track failed attempts
Implement getBackoffDelay(ip: string): Promise<number> using exponential backoff formula
Store backoff state in Redis with TTL (key pattern: ws:backoff:{ip})
Implement clearBackoff(ip: string): Promise<void> for successful auth

unit: Test checkConnectionRateLimit returns allowed=true under limit
Test checkConnectionRateLimit returns allowed=false when limit exceeded
Test getBackoffDelay returns exponential delays (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, max 60s)

criteria: Backoff delay doubles per failed attempt up to 60s max
Redis keys have appropriate TTL (2x window)
verification: Unit tests pass with 100% coverage on service methods
Manual test: rapid connections from same IP get rate limited

tasks.title: Integrate rate limiting into QueueGateway.handleConnection
tasks.description: Add rate limiting checks at the beginning of handleConnection before authentication, with exponential backoff for failed auth
implementation: Import WsConnectionRateLimiterService in queue.gateway.ts
Inject WsConnectionRateLimiterService in constructor
At start of handleConnection (after extractClientIp), call checkConnectionRateLimit(ip)
If not allowed, emit 'queue:error' with message 'Rate limit exceeded' and retryAfterMs, then disconnect
Wrap existing auth logic in try-catch that calls recordFailedAuth on auth failure
Call clearBackoff(ip) after successful authentication
Add backoff delay check: if getBackoffDelay(ip) > 0, emit error with retry delay and disconnect
Log rate limit rejections at warn level with IP (not sensitive data)

Test handleConnection applies backoff delay after failed auth

Test rate limit error includes retryAfterMs
